NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,
AUG 4 1939

Mr. D. H. Cooke
One of the leading residents of Old Shanghai passed away on Saturday at the Country Hospital in the person of Denys Cooke at the age of 53 years. He was educated at Framlingham College in England and later joined his father's firm, Harvie, Cooke & Co., arriving in Shanghai in March, 1908. Some time later he entered the services of Andersen, Meyer & Co. and was with them for six years. After this his commercial career was connected with the piece goods trade, one of his principal agencies being Thos. Edmunds & Sons. In the old Volunteer Fire Brigade days, he was a leading member of the "Victorias" and at the same time was a strong supporter of the Rowing Club. Always a keen swimmer, he played water polo for many years and latterly was a well-known referee. He was a keen golfer and when Kiangwan was the principal course, a weekend without Denys would be incomplete. When the Volunteer Firemen were disbanded he joined "A" Company, Mih-Ho-Loong Rifles, and was a prominent member up to the time of his resignation after the 1937 mobilization. He earned the Long Service Medal. Latterly, his life had been upset completely by the death of his wife and daughter. He will be greatly missed by his many friends in China and elsewhere, and the deepest sympathy is extended to his relatives in England.
At the funeral which took place at Hungjao Road Cemetery yesterday afternoon the pallbearers were:—Sir Allan Mossop, Messrs W. J. Gande, T. B. van Corback, H. S. Openshaw, H. L. Gilson and J. H. MacGregor.
The services were conducted by Dean Trivett. Among those sending floral tributes were:—Madge, Martha and Gibby, Mr. and Mrs. A. Diercking, Hinds and Barr, Friends at "Calee", Jessie, Mr. C. S. Yang, Mr. L. S. Sun, etc.
Messrs Thomas Macdonald & Co. were in charge of the funeral arrangements.

《字林西报》，
1939年8月4日

D. H. 库克先生
老上海的一位主要居民丹尼斯·库克（Denys Cooke）于周六在乡村医院去世，享年53岁。他在英国的弗拉姆林厄姆学院（Framlingham College）接受教育，后来加入其父的公司“哈维·库克公司”（Harvie, Cooke & Co.），于1908年3月抵达上海。不久后，他进入“安得生·梅耶公司”（Andersen, Meyer & Co.）任职，在那里工作了六年。此后，他的商业生涯与匹头贸易相关联，其主要代理行之一是“托马斯·埃德蒙兹父子行”（Thos. Edmunds & Sons）。在旧式志愿消防队时期，他是“维多利亚队”（Victorias）的主要成员，同时也是划船俱乐部的坚定支持者。他一直热衷于游泳，多年参加水球比赛，近期是一位知名的裁判。他也是一位狂热的高尔夫球手，当江湾是主要球场时，如果周末没有丹尼斯，活动便显得不完整。当志愿消防员解散后，他加入了“密合龙步枪队”（Mih-Ho-Loong Rifles）A连，并在1937年动员后辞职前一直是一名活跃成员。他获得了长期服务奖章。近期，妻子和女儿的去世彻底打乱了他的生活。他在中国及世界各地的众多朋友将深切怀念他，并向其在英国的亲属致以最深切的慰问。
昨天下午在虹桥路公墓举行的葬礼上，扶灵者包括：——艾伦·莫索普爵士（Sir Allan Mossop）、W. J. 甘德先生（Messrs W. J. Gande）、T. B. 范·科尔巴克先生（T. B. van Corback）、H. S. 奥彭肖先生（H. S. Openshaw）、H. L. 吉尔森先生（H. L. Gilson）和 J. H. 麦格雷戈先生（J. H. MacGregor）。
仪式由特里维特教长（Dean Trivett）主持。赠送花圈者包括：——玛奇（Madge）、玛莎（Martha）和吉比（Gibby）、A. 迪尔金先生及夫人（Mr. and Mrs. A. Diercking）、海因兹与巴尔行（Hinds and Barr）、“Calee”的朋友们、杰西（Jessie）、杨C. S.先生（Mr. C. S. Yang）、孙L. S.先生（Mr. L. S. Sun）等。
托马斯·麦克唐纳公司（Messrs Thomas Macdonald & Co.）负责葬礼安排。

归档

丹尼斯·黑兹尔伍德·库克（英国籍）于1888或1889年出生在香港，其父是知名商行“哈维·库克公司”（Harvie, Cooke & Co.）的合伙人。他在英国接受了优质的公学教育，成年后来到上海，并于1909年进入其父的公司。他在公司内晋升迅速，1912年父亲去世后，获准签署平行汇票（P.P.）。
然而在1914年之前，他任由公司事务恶化，导致该公司来自英国的赫顿先生（Mr. Hutton）被派来清算库克先生在公司的权益并接管控制权。据称，在他与“哈维·库克公司”有关联期间，尽管他混迹于当时被认为是上海最好的社交圈子，是赛马会、划船俱乐部、上海高尔夫球会和轻骑兵队的成员，但他过着放荡的生活。据说多年来，无论是在上海与亡妻结婚之前还是之后（这段婚姻发生在他效力于“哈维·库克公司”期间），他都是苏州路和江西路妓院的常客。离开“哈维·库克公司”后，他将妻子留在上海，前往英国处理事务并试图重新开始生活。由于未能立足，据说他向其岳父借款3,500.00美元，用于

Cooke) died during 1939 in Shanghai, following a long
illness during which her child was in the care of
Mrs. W. Bradbeer of the Shanghai Telephone Co., who
resides at Lane 1221, House 14 (4th floor) Yu Yuen
Road. Prior to her death, Mrs. Marsh is stated to
have signed a document entitling her father, Dennis
H. Cooke, to the custody of her child. Meanwhile,
the child is in the care of Mrs. Bradbeer, who is
stated to be giving it every attention and who is
desirous of adopting it. Since the death of his
daughter, Mr. Cooke has evinced an interest in his
granddaughter which is in great contrast to his life
long neglect of his late wife and daughter. The

the custody of his granddaughter is due to a personal

to any natural feelings of solicitude for the welfare
of the child. When it is borne in mind that Cooke
is in poor financial circumstances and is without the
means to afford the care due to a child of some four
years of age, there appears to be good reason to doubt
his motives.

Cooke is reputed to be receiving financial
assistance from Mrs. Madeline Howells, an employee of
the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Distributors, Ltd., who resides
in a boarding house at Lane 41, Nos. 70-72, Carter
Road, with whom he is stated to be on intimate terms.

Since 1930, Cooke has been residing in
various boarding houses in the Settlement. At the
present time he occupies a room in a boarding house at
Lane 41, House 10 Carter Road, which is under the
supervision of Mrs. Howells, aforesaid, though in
fact it is owned by a Chinese.

他想取得孙女监护权的愿望是由于他对布拉德比尔夫人怀有的个人怨恨，而非出于对孩子福祉的自然关怀。考虑到库克经济状况不佳，且无力提供照顾一个四岁左右儿童所需的条件，人们有充分理由怀疑他的动机。

据称，库克正从怡中烟草分销有限公司（Yee Tsoong Tobacco Distributors, Ltd.）的员工玛德琳·豪威尔斯夫人（Mrs. Madeline Howells）那里获得经济援助，他住在卡特路41弄70-72号的寄宿公寓里，据称与她关系亲密。

自1930年以来，库克一直居住在租界内的各个寄宿公寓。目前，他住在卡特路10号41弄的一间寄宿公寓房间里，该公寓由上述豪威尔斯夫人监管，尽管实际上它归一名中国人所有。
